sender: Event Team, Stonehaven Perspectives Webinar Series
subject: Webinar invite (Tue Oct 27, 1:00pm ET): Is Amazon preparing outside capital for Zoox? Our panel weighs the signals
body:
Dear Ellen,

You are invited to a 45-minute live webinar from our Disruptive Platforms series.

Title: Is Amazon Quietly Lining Up Outside Capital for Zoox?
Date: Tuesday, October 27, 1:00-1:45pm ET
Format: Webinar with moderated Q&A. Replay available to registrants.

Why now? Over the past few weeks, several threads have caught our attention:
- A job posting for a "VP, Strategic Finance, Autonomous Mobility" that mentions "external investor relations"
- A post on a well-followed investing forum claiming that "a Gulf sovereign fund has been shown a deck" (no named source, no documents)
- A Delaware entity name registration that may or may not be related to Zoox
- A comment from an unnamed former Zoox employee at an industry mixer

None of these have been confirmed by Amazon, and we have not independently verified any of them. Our panel will discuss what a minority raise might mean for the autonomous ride-hailing market, what a valuation might look like, and what it could signal about Amazon's willingness to fund long-dated bets.

Panelists:
- Moderator: Gerald Pruitt, Stonehaven Perspectives
- Dana Whitfield, independent mobility consultant
- Tomas Reyes, venture investor, autonomous trucking
